/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;> simp_all [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
    Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case fvar => simp [List.Subset]
  case op => simp [List.Subset]
  case const => simp [List.Subset]
  case bvar => simp [List.Subset]
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.app
      · exact List.Subset.trans cih (by simp [List.Subset])
      · exact List.Subset.trans tih (by simp [List.Subset])
    · exact List.Subset.trans eih (by simp [List.Subset])
  case quant trih eih =>
    apply List.Subset.app
    · exact List.Subset.trans trih (by simp [List.Subset])
    · exact List.Subset.trans eih (by simp [List.Subset])
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    apply List.Subset.app
    · exact List.Subset.trans ih1 (by simp [List.Subset])
    · exact List.Subset.trans ih2 (by simp [List.Subset])
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        exact ih2 Hin
    · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
      apply List.Subset.app
      · exact List.Subset.trans ih1 (by simp [List.Subset])
      · exact List.Subset.trans ih2 (by simp [List.Subset])
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
